title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 30th July 2026 | TV5 Money

recommendations.price: called a dark horse at 901; nothing fresh at current levels
recommendations.note: Good sector (battery metals) but too early to comment - heavy investment still needed and you need deep pockets.
recommendations.detail: The anchor asked him directly whether Deccan Gold Mines can be bought, with MD Hanuma Prasad on the show. Kutumba Rao said they had once called it a dark horse when it was at 901, having looked at Geo Mysore and all its developments, so freshly, no. One thing though: this is a good sector - nickel, carbon, whatever the battery materials are, and the demand for them in the future is all good. However it is too early to make a comment, because a great many investments still have to be made; critical minerals extraction is not an easy point and you need deep pockets too.

recommendations.price: caller holding at 798; consolidated PE not even 14
recommendations.note: Stay invested - the worst is over and the consolidated PE is not even 14, a level last seen 20 years ago.
recommendations.detail: Swapna holds HDFC Bank at Rs 798 and asked whether to add or exit; another analyst suggested shifting to ICICI Bank, and the anchor then asked Kutumba Rao whether he had a contra view. He said he would stay in HDFC Bank itself, because the worst is over. It needs some time, because all the problems started from the time HDFC was merged into HDFC Bank and then with Atanu Chakraborty garu's comments - all of that is the worst, so what more can there be than this. Moreover, as of now the consolidated PE ratio is not even 14, and the last time HDFC Bank's PE was seen at 14 was about 20 years ago. So he would stay invested.

recommendations.note: Operator-controlled with almost no float after the equity reduction - these are not wealth creators.
recommendations.detail: Mahidhar asked about buying Viceroy Hotels at current levels for three to five years; the anchor noted they have only the one hotel near Tank Bund and asked Kutumba Rao. He said the stock has now gone into operator control, after all the equity reduction was completed, so there isn't much float. Even on a standalone basis they showed some result margins and they have brought the stock close to its 52-week high. 'These are not wealth creators - they are stocks that are like boarding a running bus and getting off a running bus.'
